thread:
incident-bot: [PAGING] Streaming error surge: tenant=bigco-enterprise, pool=dp-bigco-eu-01, symptom=frequent websocket closes + 502/504 on streaming upgrade path. Customer gateway retries observed. High dup token billing alert. Paging @naomi @rafael @juno

naomi: I'm on call. TL;DR: streaming only (websocket/streaming upgrade) degraded for BigCo EU pool. Kicking off triage: is this edge, pool, or customer gateway?

rafael: Observability: edge shows many 502/504 responses for the streaming upgrade (http 101/upgrade flow) between 2026-08-11T02:12:10Z and 02:16:00Z. Backend returns are fine when routed to other tenants. dp-bigco-eu-01 node logs show rapid short-lived connections.

juno: Customer (BigCo) says their app gateway has a retry policy that spins up a retry every 5s for upgrade failures. They also enforce a 60s idle-close on websockets. Their gateway's retry multiplier is aggressive.

infra-bot: dp-bigco-eu-01 stats: cpu=38% gpu=22% active_streams=2.3k conn_open_rate_spike=+420% ephemeral_ports_used=15.8k (ephemeral_range 32768-61000)

network: We see NAT translations hitting high churn. NAT device avg_port_lifetime is very short because clients reconnect aggressively. Some SNAT mappings are timing out early due to ephemeral port reuse; reset behaviour appears at the edge.

naomi: That matches customer report: their gateway retries on any non-2xx/101 and establishes new connections; this duplicates requests when the original actually succeeded server-side but the gateway timed out waiting for initial streaming handshake. We need to stop the storm ASAP. Proposals: 1) temporary tenant-level connection cap (concurrency ceiling) at edge for bigco-enterprise; 2) enable streaming idempotency dedupe in the edge proxy using x-stream-id header; 3) request BigCo to relax retries to exponential backoff or disable immediate retry; 4) long-term: sticky persistent tunnel or dedicated NAT appliance.

rafael: I can apply a tenant circuit-breaker and limit concurrent streaming upgrades to 250 (from current ~1.6k). I'll also enable a temporary dedupe filter that looks for x-client-stream-id or x-retry-id (if present) for 30s window. CLI:

```
# restrict streaming concurrency and enable dedupe
redwood tenant-config set --tenant bigco-enterprise --streaming-concurrency 250
redwood edge-filter enable dedupe --tenant bigco-enterprise --header x-client-stream-id --window 30s
```

juno: I'll contact BigCo on their escalation channel. If they can't change gateway behavior, ask them to set the gateway to preserve the same TCP connection for at least 120s and to stop immediate full-connection retries on non-2xx for streaming endpoints.

account-eng: BigCo wants us to provide a mitigation without app changes. They are concerned about production traffic. They're asking for a failover routing to a different dedicated pool in the same region.

naomi: We can do a failover, but it only helps if we also stop the client retries causing duplication. I'll start with the tenant cap and dedupe to reduce load, then create a weighted failover route (10%) to dp-bigco-eu-02.

infra-bot: tenant cap applied. Concurrency for streaming now 250. Observability: new streams accepted dropped ~70% within 20s. 502/504 on edge down ~65%.

network: NAT table entries stabilized ~9k after cap. No nodes showing port exhaustion.

rafael: Pushing a canary route now:

```
redwood route update --tenant bigco-enterprise --add-backend dp-bigco-eu-02 --weight 10 --sticky streaming
```

rafael: Canary up. Early signals show dp-bigco-eu-02 sustaining longer-lived connections (avg 3m) vs dp-bigco-eu-01 (avg 18s pre-mitigation).

juno: BigCo engineering just replied: they can't fully change retries during their SLA maintenance window, but they can set keepalive to 90s for some front doors and will try to preserve TCP for longer. They also asked for a temporary token credit if duplicates are billed.

account-eng: Acknowledged. I'll prepare a goodwill credit if we confirm duplicates and deliver a follow-up within 6 hours. Drafting a short customer note: summary of actions + ask for change window.

security-bot: Note: enabling dedupe filter is a controlled change; make sure we log request IDs for audit and not drop any authorization headers. Approving with audit logging enabled.

naomi: Good catch. Rafael, toggle audit logs on the dedupe filter. Also let's avoid any global changes; keep everything tenant-scoped.

rafael: audit logging toggled on edge dedupe filter. Also broached a kernel tweak on pool nodes to increase net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range to expand ephemeral ports for dp-bigco-eu-01 as a stopgap. Rolling plan laid out: increase range, restart socket manager (no full node reboot).

infra-bot: net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range updated to 20000 65000 on node group; socket-manager restart completed on a drained node. No regressions observed.

naomi: After these mitigations: metrics update?

infra-bot: 10m after fixes: edge 502/504 for tenant down 72%, active_streams on dp-bigco-eu-01 down 58%, avg session duration increased to 2.5m, dup-billing alerts suppressed.

juno: BigCo confirms fewer duplicates and says UX improved for streaming features. They still want a durable architecture: recommended work items in postmortem: 1) update integration docs to recommend idempotent stream identifiers and backoff strategies, 2) optionally provision a dedicated NAT gateway for committed pools, 3) enable sticky tunnels for streaming traffic, 4) implement server-side streaming ack of first-frame to reduce gateway uncertainty.

rafael: I'll open infra tickets for NAT appliance sizing and for adding tenant-scoped sticky-tunnel support. I'll also add a feature ticket for stream-id enforced dedupe in the edge (configurable retention window).

account-eng: I'll schedule customer follow-up and include billing review. Also prepping a friendly advisory note for BigCo with specific gateway config snippets they can apply.

naomi: Handing off monitoring to @rafael for 45m. I'll remain on-call for escalation. Severity classified as degraded-impacting (streaming only). Filing post-incident writeup and coordinating postmortem with BigCo next week.

infra-bot: final snapshot: nat_table_entries steady at 9.6k, tcp_rst_rate -82%, new_session_rate normalized.

naomi: Thanks all. Follow-ups: rafael: infra tickets + finalize dedupe retention tuning. juno/account-eng: customer comms + billing. security-bot: confirm audit logs retained 90 days for dedupe events. I'll close paging; reopen if recurrence. :white_check_mark:
